name: Global Chinese Business Club
summary: Global Chinese Business Club, an investment holding company, provides services related to foundation works in Hong Kong. It provides excavation and lateral support works; pile caps construction; and other services, such as demolition, underground drainage, earth, and structural steel works. The company also offers machinery and equipment rental services. It serves construction work companies. Global Chinese Business Club was formerly known as Affluent Foundation Holdings Limited and changed its name to Global Chinese Business Club in February 2026. The company was founded in 1996 and is headquartered in Central, Hong Kong.
